standardsRefs: Ready for Life v1, Grade 4 Unit 1: Home Care Routines That Last
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice storage that works. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner picks a group of items in their household that tend to end up scattered because they don't have a storage spot that works, such as loose art supplies, shoes, or shared game pieces.
materials: adult-or-local: a group of real items that currently lack a working storage spot
learner-local: two possible storage containers, shelves, or spots to compare
learner-local: paper or a notes app

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Explain which storage option you will keep using for these items going forward and why a storage spot has to match how you actually use the items, not just look organized.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Comparison rigor: Both storage options are tested by actually retrieving and putting away the same items. | Justification of choice: A specific reason is given, connected to speed, visibility, or fit. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner set up a third storage option for the same items using a completely different grouping rule and determine whether it beats the winner from the first comparison.

resources.title: storage that works worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner picks a group of items in their household that tend to end up scattered because they don't have a storage spot that works, such as loose art supplies, shoes, or shared game pieces.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact storage that works decision or action.
Model move 2: Pick one group of items that regularly ends up scattered or hard to find.
Model move 3: Set up two different storage options for the same items: Option A grouped one way, like by type, and Option B grouped another way, like by how often each item is used.

Model check: Comparison rigor: Both storage options are tested by actually retrieving and putting away the same items. | Justification of choice: A specific reason is given, connected to speed, visibility, or fit.

content: 1. Read the goal for storage that works.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-guided-card.

5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: storage that works coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner picks a group of items in their household that tend to end up scattered because they don't have a storage spot that works, such as loose art supplies, shoes, or shared game pieces.
Coach direction: Pick one group of items that regularly ends up scattered or hard to find.
Learner prompt: Name the items and describe where they usually end up when they aren't put away.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: storage that works complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Set up two different storage options for the same items: Option A grouped one way, like by type, and Option B grouped another way, like by how often each item is used.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I set up Option A and put all the items away using that grouping.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I set up Option B and put all the items away using that different grouping.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I noted how long each option took and whether items fit without being crammed or scattered.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: storage that works minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Explain which storage option you will keep using for these items going forward and why a storage spot has to match how you actually use the items, not just look organized.

Success checks: Comparison rigor: Both storage options are tested by actually retrieving and putting away the same items. | Justification of choice: A specific reason is given, connected to speed, visibility, or fit.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: storage that works supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional storage that works condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Comparison rigor: Both storage options are tested by actually retrieving and putting away the same items. | Justification of choice: A specific reason is given, connected to speed, visibility, or fit..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: storage that works — complete fictional route

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u01-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
